capabilities: Insert rich text and sticky notes.
intentEvidence: NotePages bridges the gap between structured Markdown note-taking and the fluid freedom of physical pen-and-paper.
motivation: The author built it to bridge the gap between structured Markdown note-taking and the fluid freedom of physical pen-and-paper while maintaining 100% offline local privacy.
problem: It addresses the gap between structured Markdown note-taking and the fluid, freeform nature of physical pen-and-paper workflows.
summary: NotePages is a high-performance digital notebook and whiteboard for Obsidian that allows users to create multi-page documents using stylus inking, paper templates, and LaTeX math.
